name: zoom-mcp-cloud-functions
description: Zoom MCP cloud functions - OAuth, webhook handler, and API proxy

scripts.deploy:oauth: set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; set +a; npm run build && gcloud functions deploy zoom-mcp-oauth --gen2 --region=europe-west1 --project=zoom-mcp-oauth --runtime=nodejs20 --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --entry-point=oauth --source=. --set-secrets=ZOOM_CLIENT_SECRET=zoom-mcp-client-secret:latest --set-env-vars=ZOOM_CLIENT_ID=${ZOOM_CLIENT_ID:?missing - add it to .env in the repo root} --set-build-env-vars=GOOGLE_NODE_RUN_SCRIPTS=
scripts.deploy:webhook: set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; set +a; npm run build && gcloud functions deploy zoom-webhook-handler --gen2 --region=europe-west1 --project=zoom-mcp-oauth --runtime=nodejs20 --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --entry-point=webhookHandler --source=. --set-env-vars=ZOOM_ADMIN_ACCOUNT_ID=${ZOOM_ADMIN_ACCOUNT_ID:?missing - add it to .env in the repo root},ZOOM_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID=${ZOOM_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID:?missing - add it to .env in the repo root} --set-secrets=ZOOM_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET=zoom-admin-client-secret:latest,ZOOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET_TOKEN=zoom-webhook-secret-token:latest --set-build-env-vars=GOOGLE_NODE_RUN_SCRIPTS=
scripts.deploy:api: set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; set +a; npm run build && gcloud functions deploy zoom-proxy-api --gen2 --region=europe-west1 --project=zoom-mcp-oauth --runtime=nodejs20 --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --entry-point=proxyApi --source=. --set-env-vars=ZOOM_ADMIN_ACCOUNT_ID=${ZOOM_ADMIN_ACCOUNT_ID:?missing - add it to .env in the repo root},ZOOM_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID=${ZOOM_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID:?missing - add it to .env in the repo root} --set-secrets=ZOOM_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET=zoom-admin-client-secret:latest --set-build-env-vars=GOOGLE_NODE_RUN_SCRIPTS=
scripts.deploy:cleanup: set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; set +a; npm run build && gcloud functions deploy zoom-cleanup --gen2 --region=europe-west1 --project=zoom-mcp-oauth --runtime=nodejs20 --trigger-http --no-allow-unauthenticated --entry-point=cleanup --source=. --set-build-env-vars=GOOGLE_NODE_RUN_SCRIPTS=
